GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to joint Lead on fence settling down, Headed 1200m, Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground along rail in Straight # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 150m was obliged to steady and shift in to avoid heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , little change to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, steered just short of centre of track Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line # wide/battled fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away OK. Worked fwd & raced keenly 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & worked to =lead Two Wide @ 450m. Pushed to quicken =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pushed along Two Wide @ 250m & pressured @ 200m. Boxed on until outgunned in last 100m. # On-pace/no match
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 4 Lengths 800m 9th 5 Lengths home turn 3 Wide 8th Middle Of Track Straight made no ground final 200m # average run
Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Four Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, shuffled back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home, need to see again # inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped rounding the first turn. Near the 1000m was steadied when bumped out onto heels. Raced wide, with cover, from this point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a half length, Drifted Back to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
Jumped okay & Settled Down on fence trailing a neck, Moved Up to joint Lead at 1000m, Held Together in front & shared the lead turning, Headed 220m and kept trying to line # battled on fairly
Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside Settled Down neck Clear Held Together same to Straightening Up , dueled from 300-200m, Couldn'T Go On - # battled final 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Leaving the 100m, steadied to avoid heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind speed 3 Lengths 800m, weakened in Straight # dropped out rails
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that his mount travelled comfortably in the early and middle stages behind the leaders. Rdr stated that when asked to sprint on straightening his mount failed to let down on the heavy track conditions and weakened in its run to the line. Rdr added all of his mount wins have come on good track conditions. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn then shifted out to 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , steered Four Wide at the 400m, hit Lead 250m, kept going in Straight # just held on/solid
